verdict.rationale: Decagon's first-party docs describe natural language across several core surfaces: agent behavior is defined in natural-language AOPs instead of SDKs, Watchtower flagging criteria are written in natural language, and Ask AI answers open-ended analytics questions conversationally. Duet also generates AOPs and tests and iterates on the agent. missing for 10: evidence of a single natural-language command interface that operates the whole product (e.g., experiments, integrations, deployment), clear documentation that Duet takes direct conversational commands, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
